ingredients.name: Boursin Garlic and Fine Herbs

ingredients.name: Deli Chicken, cooked and cut into bite-size pieces
ingredients.originalText: 3 cup Deli Chicken, cooked and cut into bite-size pieces

instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 3 Tbsp Butter; 8 oz Mushrooms, sliced; 1 small Red Pepper, chopped; 1 small Onion, finely chopped; 1 clove Garlic, minced; 3 Tbsp All-Purpose Flour; 4 cups Milk; 2 Tbsp Worcestershire Sauce; 8 oz Extra Broad Egg Noodles; 5 oz Boursin Garlic and Fine Herbs; 3 cup Deli Chicken, cooked and cut into bite-size pieces; 1/2 cup Frozen Peas; 1/2 cup Fresh Parsley, chopped; Small Fresh Basil Leaves (optional); Parmesan, grated. Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Mushrooms: sliced; Red Pepper: small; chopped; Onion: small; finely chopped; Garlic: minced; Parsley: Fresh; chopped; Parmesan: grated. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add mushrooms, red pepper, onion and garlic; cook, stirring about 5 minutes until tender.
Gradually whisk in milk then Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Stirring occasionally, bring to a boil.
Add noodles, reduce heat to a low boil.
Stirring constantly and around edges of pan, cook until pasta is tender, about 7 minutes.
Stir in chunks of Boursin, then chicken, peas, and parsley, stirring until chicken is hot and Boursin is melted.

Before serving, insert a food thermometer into the thickest piece of chicken or turkey, away from bone: it must reach 165°F (74°C). If using already-cooked poultry, reheat it to 165°F (74°C). Continue cooking and recheck if needed; wash hands and utensils after handling raw poultry and do not rinse it.
Serve sprinkled with basil and Parmesan.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Joel Maxuel
source.originalInstructions:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms, red pepper, onion and garlic; cook, stirring about 5 minutes until tender.
2. Sprinkle with flour and stir. Gradually whisk in milk then Worcestershire, salt and pepper. Stirring occasionally, bring to a boil.
3. Add noodles, reduce heat to a low boil. Stirring constantly and around edges of pan, cook until pasta is tender, about 7 minutes.
4. Stir in chunks of Boursin, then chicken, peas, and parsley, stirring until chicken is hot and Boursin is melted. Serve sprinkled with basil and Parmesan.
